note: Module provides a media source plugin media_tylerdi (string_long source field), a field formatter media_tyler_data_insights, and a validation constraint media_tyler_data_insights. Its only config is media_tyler_data_insights.settings -> allowed_hosts (sequence of https:// origins), edited at /admin/config/media/tyler-data-insights (permission 'administer media_tyler_data_insights hosts'). Medium cases are grounded in the real allowed_hosts config. Hard cases: (1) add an allowed host to the live config; (2) create a Media type whose source is media_tylerdi. reset/cleanup restore baseline (allowed_hosts empty; no media type sourced by media_tylerdi). The site has no shipped config/install for the settings object, so baseline allowed_hosts is empty.

evals.prompt: In the Drupal module Media: Tyler Technologies Data & Insights, what is the machine id of the media source plugin it provides, and what field type stores the pasted embed snippet?
evals.expected_output: The media source plugin id is media_tylerdi ('Tyler Data & Insights'); its source field is a string_long field that stores the pasted embed/share snippet.

evals.prompt: Where does the Media: Tyler Data & Insights module store the list of hosts that visualizations may be embedded from, and at what admin path do you edit it?
evals.expected_output: In the config object media_tyler_data_insights.settings under the allowed_hosts key, edited on the settings form at /admin/config/media/tyler-data-insights (permission 'administer media_tyler_data_insights hosts'). Each host is an https:// origin with no path.

evals.prompt: What does the Media: Tyler Data & Insights validation constraint check before it accepts a pasted embed code?
evals.expected_output: The value must contain exactly one iframe, whose src path matches /w/... or /stories/..., and whose host is in the configured allowed_hosts list; otherwise it is rejected with an invalid-embed or invalid-host message.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Media: Tyler Data & Insights module has been configured with an allowed embed host. Inspect the live media_tyler_data_insights.settings config and report the allowed host.
evals.expected_output: The allowed host is https://data.mdi-eval.gov, listed in media_tyler_data_insights.settings allowed_hosts.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, several embed hosts are allowed for Media: Tyler Data & Insights. Inspect the live media_tyler_data_insights.settings config and report how many hosts are allowed and name one of them.
evals.expected_output: Two hosts are allowed: https://opendata.mdi-eval.com and https://insights.mdi-eval.com (media_tyler_data_insights.settings allowed_hosts).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, configure Media: Tyler Data & Insights to allow embeds from the host https://data.mditask.gov by adding it to the allowed hosts. Apply the change to the live media_tyler_data_insights.settings configuration.
evals.expected_output: media_tyler_data_insights.settings allowed_hosts contains 'https://data.mditask.gov' (set the sequence via the settings form or the config API).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, create a new Media type that uses the Tyler Data & Insights media source (plugin media_tylerdi) so editors can add Data & Insights visualizations as media. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: A media type config entity exists whose source plugin is media_tylerdi (with a string_long source field, e.g. created via the 'Add media type' UI or MediaType::create([...'source'=>'media_tylerdi']) plus createSourceField()).
